name: Studio portrait
means: A person lit deliberately against a controlled background: a key light with a defined shadow edge, fill setting the ratio, a rim separating hair from the backdrop, and a seamless ground with nothing else in it.
prose: a studio portrait, large softbox key at 45 degrees camera left, subtle fill holding a 3:1 lighting ratio, hair light separating the subject from a plain grey seamless backdrop, 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp eyes, smooth even skin
negative_add: cluttered background, harsh on-camera flash, illustration, anime, cgi
works_for: video only in part. The backdrop and the lighting hold because they are flat and static; the face does not, and a close portrait crop is where i2v boiling is most visible. Inferred.
note: The most reliable card in this set, because it is nothing but nouns: modifier, angle, ratio, backdrop, focal length. PROMPTING.md records that focal length and lighting are the two highest-leverage words in a qwen prompt, and this style is made entirely of those two. It fails only when you name a mood instead of a light - 'dramatic portrait' does nothing, 'single hard key, no fill, background falling to black' does the whole job. The anime checkpoint has its own clean-portrait idiom (solo, upper body, simple background, soft lighting), but that is an anime portrait: a different medium, not this style. | Downgraded to untested: NOTHING in this library was rendered when it was authored, so every strength and engine call is a considered prediction. This project's own standard - written on the Illustrious checkpoint card - is that a recommendation is not a measurement.
verdict: Controlled key, clean falloff, dropped background.
verified_by: Looked at, against the no-style control at the same seed with the same subject. studio/_tools/style_examples.py
